{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity
df_filtered = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered population
n_total = len(df_filtered)

# Count how many responded
n_responded = df_filtered['responded'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

print(f'Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {n_total}')
print(f'Number who responded: {n_responded}')
print(f'Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}')"}
